content:
Ellison Park: Morning all  hi from my first commute to PDX office! Quick checklist Qs: 1) Is the VPN cert tied to the MDM device profile or my account? 2) Where do we log parking passes? 3) Who has spare HDMI adapters in the office? Fun fact: I bake levain (sourdough) and brought a tiny jar of starter named 'Levainette' for whoever wants a taste later :bread:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome, Ellison! :tada: VPN certs are provisioned after MDM enrollment; if MDM hasn't synced within 2h run `it-sync --status` and file a ticket if it still shows pending. Parking passes are requested via facilities.redwood.internal/accounts -> "parking". We logged a hardware-share message to #office-hardware.
Tara Nguyen: welcome Ellison!! :wave: Im your onboarding buddy. I have an HDMI->USB-C dongle you can borrow. Ill swing by your desk at 11:30 to say hi and bring it. For VPN, once MDM shows the device, the certificate appears in your profile (no extra steps). If anything is weird, DM me and Ill page IT.
Samir Patel: hey ellison  welcome to infra. Re: runbooks, we keep them in confluence under 'Infra > Onboarding > Workstations'. There's a short script for dev-env: `./scripts/setup_dev.sh` (run as non-root). If your laptop boots into a corporate profile but you're missing groups, open a ticket with `it-access` and request `infra-read` and `infra-dev`.
Juno Baker: hi Ellison, welcome! If youd like a quick intro to our CI and deployment flow, happy to do a 30min pairing this afternoon. Also cupcakes in the kitchen on Fridays (we try to keep one savory option too).
Ellison Park: thanks everyone  feeling very welcomed. Ive requested parking via the form and added a comment on the MDM invite. Tara, 11:30 works  see you then. Also I'll put a tiny jar of Levainette in the fridge labeled 'Ellison - starter - free samples' for anyone curious :grin:
Onboarding-Bot: IT ticket #IT-9039 opened for MDM sync. Facilities ticket #FAC-4999 opened for parking pass. Youll receive updates here.
Samir Patel: nice, Levainette sounds dangerous (in the best way). If youre into bake swaps, @bakeswap channel exists but its small :laughing:
Tara Nguyen: also added you to `#eng-runtime`, `#oncall-ops`, and `#lunch-plans`. Ping me if you want to join a 1pm welcome lunch (were heading to the thai place two blocks over).
Ellison Park: 1pm lunch sounds great, count me in. Thanks again all!
